propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property currently accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (missing or empty ticket_id) on all four surfaces (show, list, search, ready)
Seeded faults F3 and F6 (empty object and object missing ticket_id respectively) pass the current property but fail the original regression test, indicating a detection gap

The property must be strengthened to enforce per-surface content-completeness predicates: show returns object with truthy ticket_id; list/search/ready return arrays where every element carries truthy ticket_id
The strengthened property treats valid-empty arrays as passing (vacuously true via all() on empty sequences) to remain distinguishable from truncated output
The fix is assertion-only with no new subprocess invocations, rounds, or fixtures, preserving wall-clock runtime
